review_information.notes:
No account and no sign-in anywhere in the app. First launch shows a two-step setup: a language list, then a topic picker that needs at least one topic before "Start reading" is enabled. Nothing else is required.

Where the articles come from: no news API is wired into this build, so the feed, Trending, Search, the category rail and the hashtag pages all read from a bundled set of eleven example articles compiled into the binary. Their timestamps are calculated against the current time, so they always read as recent. This is offline sample content, not a failed request. "Read full story" opens the publisher's page (TechCrunch, Reuters, BBC and similar) in the external browser, which is the only outbound network use in the app.

Three things that might otherwise look like defects, each of which the app also states on screen:
- "NewsBoard Premium" lists three price tiers, but no store billing is connected. The button only flips a local setting and shows a message saying no payment was taken. There is no in-app purchase product in this build and no external payment path.
- Opening a stock symbol shows a message that no market-data provider is connected, rather than displaying an invented quote.
- The language picked during setup is saved as a preference, but the app's own screen text and the bundled articles are English.

The empty bars above the feed are in-app placeholders for a future ad slot; no ad SDK is linked and they show no third-party content. Bookmarks, followed topics and theme are stored on the device.
